pages.text:
A **missile assembler** builds [missiles](ordnance/missiles): one for each class of warhead, each a bigger structure than the last and a harder one to craft. Each takes only its own class: a warhead of that class, the class's missile body, a motor that fits it, and optionally a guidance unit and Hardened Electronics. Its screen is the [bench's](ordnance/assembly), with the missile the parts make turning in the window on the right. Press **Assemble**; while it works the crane lays the missile out section by section (motor and fins, then the body, then the warhead) and the finished missile waits on the cradles until you take it out. **Take Apart** gives every part back. Each draws power through an Energy Port, and pipes feed and empty it through an Item Port.

**Light** (class S: HE, Napalm, Chemical, Toxic Waste, Dirty): 10 seconds at 20 FE a tick. **Medium** (class M: Heavy HE, Cluster, Poison Gas, Smoke, Cryo): 15 seconds at 40 FE a tick. These two also build [cruise missiles](ordnance/missiles): give one a Cruise Engine for its motor. **Heavy** (class L: Thermobaric, Bunker Buster, EMP, Massive Ordnance): 20 seconds at 80 FE a tick. **Strategic** (class XL, the nuclear warheads): 30 seconds at 160 FE a tick.

The Light Missile Assembler: a 3 by 6 deck of Launch Pads, the controller in the middle of the front edge, the Item Port and the Energy Port on either side of the fifth row. An A-frame stands over each end: a Gantry Frame block on each side, two high. A Crane Rail runs the deck's length three blocks up, over the middle: the hoist beam. Keep the middle clear under it, the missile lies there.

The Medium Missile Assembler: a 5 by 7 deck of Launch Pads, the controller in the middle of the front edge, the Item Port and the Energy Port in the back row. The slewing jib crane's post, Gantry Frame four high, stands in the middle of the side on your left as you face the controller. Keep the middle three columns clear two blocks up: the missile's bay.

The Heavy Missile Assembler: a 5 by 9 deck, its two outer columns Crane Rail (the gantry crane's track) and the rest Launch Pads, the controller in the middle of the front edge, the Item Port and the Energy Port in the back row. The crane stands parked over the back row: a Gantry Frame leg four high on each rail and a row of Crane Rail across the top. Everything over the deck in front of it must be clear, for the crane to run and the missile to lie.

The Strategic Missile Assembler, an integration tower: a 5 by 5 deck of Launch Pads, the controller in the middle of the front edge, the Item Port and the Energy Port in the back row. A Gantry Frame column eleven high stands on each corner; on top, a Crane Rail girder runs down each side and another across the middle, the hoist's beam. The middle three by three must be clear: the missile stands there on its stand, stacked stage on stage, and work platforms fold down round it.

**Crafting, a ladder.** Each assembler's controller takes better parts than the last: the Light's servos and basic circuits, the Medium's electric motors and an advanced circuit, the Heavy's pressure vessels (its hydraulics), tungsten and a military circuit, the Strategic's lead-lined casing, two military circuits and a sensor array. At the top, the [Strategic Assembly Hall](ordnance/strategic_assembly) takes superconducting coils and three military circuits.
